en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4381 - Muhammad ibn al-Walid narrated from al-Husayn ibn Bashshar, who said:
I wrote to Abu Ja'far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) concerning a man who proposed marriage to someone.
Imam (as) replied: "If someone proposes to you, and you are satisfied with his religion and trustworthiness, then marry him, whoever he may be. If you do not do so,
there will be 'fitnah (discord) on the earth and great corruption.'"
